title: Understanding Bootstrap Replicates
text: Bootstrap replicates are samples drawn with replacement from the original data. Each replicate is used to calculate statistics like mean, variance, and median.

title: Effect of Increasing Sample Size
text: Increasing the size of each bootstrap replicate generally leads to a decrease in the variance of the sample mean. This is because larger samples tend to provide more stable estimates of the population parameters.

title: Analyzing the Table
